title: Locality of weighted approximate tangent spaces (Simon Ch. 3, 1.5(2), 1.8(1))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, M₁, M₂ ⊆ U null-measurable for H^n := μHE[n], and θ₁, θ₂ : ℝ^P → ℝ with θ_i > 0 on M_i and θ_i H^n-integrable on M_i ∩ K for every compact K ⊆ U (i = 1, 2). Then for H^n-a.e. x ∈ M₁ ∩ M₂ and every linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^P: if Q is the weighted approximate tangent space of M₁ with respect to θ₁ at x (HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₁ θ₁ x Q, Simon Ch. 3, 1.7), then Q is also the weighted approximate tangent space of M₂ with respect to θ₂ at x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (M₁ M₂ : Set (Eucl P)) (θ₁ θ₂ : Eucl P → ℝ), M₁ ⊆ U → M₂ ⊆ U → NullMeasurableSet M₁ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet M₂ (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → (∀ x ∈ M₁, 0 < θ₁ x) → (∀ x ∈ M₂, 0 < θ₂ x) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ₁ (M₁ ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → IntegrableOn θ₂ (M₂ ∩ K) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict (M₁ ∩ M₂)), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₁ θ₁ x Q → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M₂ θ₂ x Q
